scope: Proposition 6.3 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4aa0d0c5f7298f8e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the extracted data of Proposition 5.3 and the model W of Proposition 6.1, take i sufficiently large. There is a finite generalized Qi,W -program W --→ Wi consisting only of flips, with the following properties: (1) Qi,Wi is nef; (2) every step is trivial for the transformed class P and for each Pj in (6.4); (3) the transformed Pj are nef adjoints of ordinary rational klt pairs, and the fixed multiples ℓjPj are line bundles; (4) every Qi,Wi -trivial curve is PWi -trivial.
